svg.title: Built on evidence
svg.desc: 35 ideas compared and 1 chosen; 57 public repositories read, 44 of them hackathon entries; 476 sourced items tested the claims behind two finalists, 385 re-opened and confirmed; 429 sourced items on daily pain grouped into 56 problems, 7 of which we build first.
svg.text: Built on evidence, with every number on the record
Counted live from the CSV files in research/data. Recount them yourself: python scripts/check_numbers.py

g.text: to avoid building what others are
quote, link and date on every row
from invoice sent to books closed
